description: A fare-tracker price alert for searched dates: travel-related, but the email itself says nothing has been booked, so no booking may be created from the searched route and dates.

files.content:
FareWatch price alert

Singapore (SIN) to Osaka (KIX)
From SGD 412 return, down 18% since last week
Searched dates: 12 Nov 2027 - 19 Nov 2027

Prices are updated every few hours and may change. You have not booked this trip. View the deal on farewatch.example to check availability.

You are receiving this because you set a price alert. Manage alerts in your account.
